english.title: Burglary other than dwelling - theft / attempt theft with violence
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), having entered as a trespasser

(A)_[a building,]_
(B)_[part of a building,]_

namely **(..SPECIFY BUILDING..),

(C)_[stole therein **(..SPECIFY THE PROPERTY..) to the value of **(..SPECIFY THE VALUE..).]_
(D)_[stole therein **(..SPECIFY THE PROPERTY..) of a value unknown.]_
(E)_[attempted to steal therein **(..SPECIFY THE PROPERTY..) to the value of **(..SPECIFY THE VALUE..).]_

when a person within the said building, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PERSON..), was subjected to

(F)_[violence]_
(G)_[a threat of violence]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 9(1)(b) of the Theft Act 1968.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
entered as a trespasser
a building/part of a building (not being a dwelling)
stole/attempted to steal
and subjected a person to violence of the threat of violence

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Mandatory drug test required if 18 or over
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: (i) IMPORTANT: Paragraph 28(c) of Schedule 1 to the Magistrates Court Act 1980 makes 'violence' a factor of the offence applying to dwellings only. As such, this is not an offence and should not be used.
